128MJ Railgun.in_game_description: The 128MJ Multirail was the first weapon in nearly 200 years to be withdrawn from the market and have its production ceased by the manufacturer. The recall was instigated due to the high instability of the weapon, which was prone to causing unpredictable, devastating explosions. Clever inventors have succeeded in recreating the weapon from materials that are relatively easy to procure.
mechanics_text: It is a good alternative for the Mass Driver MD 10.
This is the successor of the 64MJ Railgun.
Despite what the description says, it will not randomly explode, as there is no such mechanic in Galaxy on Fire 2.
The Velasco's Primary weapon slots look like this weapon but in a different color and a longer barrel.
The 128MJ multirail resembles a GAU-3 Gatling gun.

gof2_hd_overrides._note: GoF2 HD Android has a different blueprint cost: requires 1t 64MJ Railgun + 4t Mechanical Supplies + 2t Nanotech + 10t Energy Cells + 5t Plastics + 5t Microchips (~21,121 credits to produce).

128MJ Railgun.version_notes: Wiki category page lists Tech level 5, but the infobox on the item page shows Tech Level 6. Infobox is authoritative — captured as tech_level: 6. GoF2 HD Android has a modified blueprint recipe.

64MJ Railgun.in_game_description: This weapon uses a 64MJ reactor to generate lightning clouds so fast that they still contain most of their energy when they connect with their target.
mechanics_text: The 64MJ Railgun is the predecessor of the 128MJ Railgun Auto Cannon.
It looks like a M134 Minigun or M61 Vulcan.
64MJ Railgun.version_notes: Has a special 'Loma Price' row listed separately in infobox ($15,749). Captured as loma_price_credits.

mechanics_text: Scatter gun with proximity detonation. Valkyrie DLC.

Berger Focus I.version_notes: Loma Price listed separately in infobox ($22,994). Stats confirmed from individual page.

Berger Focus II A1.version_notes: Stats from category table. Successor to Berger Focus I.

Dark Matter Laser.version_notes: Kaamo Club exclusive. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: EMP blasters do not damage shields or armor, and therefore cannot destroy a ship, but deal EMP damage to disable a ship momentarily.
Successor to Sol EMP Mk II.

Disruptor Laser.version_notes: Valkyrie DLC weapon. Stats from category table.

H'nookk.version_notes: Stats from category table. Successor to Sh'gaal.

mechanics_text: Scatter gun with proximity detonation. Valkyrie DLC. Longest range scatter gun.
Icarus Heavy AS.version_notes: Valkyrie DLC. Highest tech-level scatter gun.

K'booskk.version_notes: Stats from category table. Predecessor to Sh'gaal.

mechanics_text: EMP blasters do not damage shields or armor, and therefore cannot destroy a ship, but deal EMP damage to disable a ship momentarily.
This allows for any 'loot' to be taken without having to destroy the ship.
Luna EMP Mk I.version_notes: EMP damage only — no armor/shield damage. Damage field is EMP damage, not physical.

mechanics_text: Beam laser — no projectile speed; fires a continuous beam.
M6 series continuous beam lasers deal high concentrated damage at the cost of slow loading speeds, like a sniper.
When scanner is not locked on a target, beam fires in a fixed direction.
M6 A1 \"Wolf\".version_notes: Speed listed as '(Beam)' on wiki — no projectile velocity. Beam laser fires continuously until reload.

mechanics_text: Beam laser — no projectile speed; fires a continuous beam.
Successor to M6 A1 Wolf, predecessor to M6 A3 Wolverine.
M6 A2 \"Cougar\".version_notes: Speed listed as '(Beam)' in wiki category table — no projectile velocity. Note: wiki category table placed price columns differently for M6 series — price values confirmed from table.

M6 A4 \"Raccoon\".version_notes: Kaamo Club exclusive. Beam laser. Highest DPS of the M6 series.

Mass Driver MD 10.version_notes: Stats from category table. Fastest projectile speed in the auto-cannon class.

Mass Driver MD 12.version_notes: Kaamo Club exclusive. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Thermal Fusion weapon — heat-seeking when scanner locked on target.
Auto-cannons are similar to machine guns, with high rates of fire but low projectile damage. Their recoil can cause a bit of projectile spread.
Starting weapon available in Var Hastra, along with Nirai Impulse EX 1.
Micro Gun MK I.version_notes: DPS listed as 9.09 on wiki category page. DB had 9.09 (rounded from 9.090...). Wiki is consistent.

Micro Gun MK II.version_notes: URL slug is 'Micro_Gun_MKII' (no space before II). Known slug quirk documented in task description.

Mimung Blaster.version_notes: Kaamo Club exclusive. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Scatter guns have slow loading speeds, but their projectiles are very fast and have great range.
When the projectiles are close to any ship, asteroid, or space junk, they will detonate in small explosions.
Valkyrie DLC weapon.
Successor to the Nirai Impulse EX 2; predecessor to higher-tier Nirai lasers.
Part of the Nirai EX laser family.
Nirai Charged Pulse.version_notes: Individual page not fully extracted; stats confirmed from category table. Description not found.

Nirai Impulse EX 1.in_game_description: The Nirai company once specialized in low cost, mass-market productions. Unfortunately, there was an incident in which an entire batch of Laser FX series exploded simultaneously in various locations around the galaxy, due to a date error in the on-board computer software. After the hasty closure of all the Nirai factories in Festus and Dima, no new weapons were manufactured. The lasers of the EX series are a living relic.
mechanics_text: The date error referred to in the description is a reference to the Y2K bug.
This is the only weapon Terrans use.
You start with this when you first go into Var Hastra's hanger, along with a Micro Gun MK I.
Nirai Impulse EX 1.version_notes: Starting weapon in the game. Price listed at wiki as Known Price Range.

Nirai Impulse EX 2.in_game_description: The Nirai company once specialized in low cost mass-market productions. Unfortunately there was an incident in which an entire batch of Laser FX series exploded simultaneously in various locations around the galaxy, due to a date error in the on-board computer software. After the hasty closure of all the Nirai factories in Festus and Dima, no new weapons were manufactured. The lasers of the EX series are a living relic.
mechanics_text: The date error referred to in the description is a reference to the Y2K bug.
This is the only weapon Midorians use in the SD version.
Successor to the Nirai Impulse EX 1; predecessor to the Nirai Charged Pulse.
Nirai Impulse EX 2.version_notes: Price field labelled 'Price Range' (not 'Known Price Range'). Loma Price listed separately.

N'saan.version_notes: Stats from category table. Lowest tech-level blaster.

mechanics_text: Thermal Fusion weapon — heat-seeking when scanner locked on target.

Scram Cannon.version_notes: Stats from category table. Fastest loading speed auto-cannon in base game.

Sh'gaal.in_game_description: Sh'gaal means 'scar' and refers to something every true Vossk is born with. The weapon's name is thanks to the famous warrior Zrrot Grykk who was exiled on Narsaxa. He managed to regain the favor of the leader, which he had previously lost after making inappropriate advances.
mechanics_text: One is preinstalled in a T'Suum.
This is the successor of the K'booskk and the predecessor to the H'nookk.
Not to be confused with Sh'Gaal (Galaxy on Fire 3).
Sh'gaal.version_notes: NEW item — not in the original catalog of 40 primary weapons. Vossk blaster, successor to K'booskk and predecessor to H'nookk. Pre-installed in a T'Suum sentry gun.

Sh'koom.in_game_description: The overhauled successor to the V'skorr can deliver more damage even though it also has an increased speed and only a minimally decreased rate of fire.
mechanics_text: The Sh'koom is a Vossk laser weapon, and is mounted on all Vossk ships in GOF2.

The V'skorr's description says that it is the standard laser weapon of the Vossk Empire, but all H'Soc fighters use the Sh'koom, indicated by its sound when firing, so it is technically not the standard weapon.
Sh'koom.version_notes: NEW item — not in the original catalog of 40 primary weapons. Vossk faction weapon, successor to V'skorr. Mounted on all Vossk ships in GoF2.

mechanics_text: EMP blasters do not damage shields or armor, and therefore cannot destroy a ship, but deal EMP damage to disable a ship momentarily.
Successor to Luna EMP Mk I, predecessor to Dia EMP Mk III.
Thermal Fusion weapon — heat-seeking when scanner locked on target.
Valkyrie DLC weapon.
SunFire o50.version_notes: Valkyrie DLC. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Thermal Fusion weapons are slightly slower, but deal more damage per projectile than auto-cannons.
When the scanner is locked onto a target, the projectiles will aim towards it, making them good fire-and-forget weapons.
They will fire everywhere if not locked on a target.
Thermic o5.version_notes: Stats from category table. Thermal fusion weapons have heat-seeking behavior when scanner locked.

Tyrfing Blaster.version_notes: DPS 59.09 — wiki shows 59.09, DB had 59.09. Category page shows 59.09. Confirmed.

V'skorr.in_game_description: The V'skorr is the standard laser weapon of the Vossk Empire. It is manufactured in huge numbers and exported everywhere. A cheap but effective weapon.
mechanics_text: The V'skorr laser is the predecessor of the Sh'koom laser.
V'skorr.version_notes: NEW item — not in the original catalog of 40 primary weapons. Vossk faction weapon, predecessor to Sh'koom.

mechanics_text: Highest damage nuke in the game. Massive 40000m blast radius.
High-damage nuke with massive 30000m blast radius. Not steerable.
Mines float wherever they were launched and only detonate within proximity of any ship.
They have a limited time to detonate after they are released (40 seconds for AMR Saber).
After this time has passed, and it has not detonated, the mine will simply vanish without explosion.
Valkyrie DLC mine.
AMR Saber.version_notes: Mine — deploys at launch position, detonates on proximity. 40s lifetime. 500m trigger radius.

mechanics_text: Nukes deal massive amounts of damage at high magnitudes.
Be careful when detonating nukes, because opposing factions in a firefight may team up temporarily and attack you instead.
If a nuke is detonated too close to your ship on Extreme difficulty, your ship will take damage.
AMR Tormentor.version_notes: Not steerable. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Rocket with both physical and EMP damage. Cannot be guided.
Armour Rocket.version_notes: Wiki page URL is 'Amour_Rocket' (missing 'r' — spelling error on wiki). Item name is 'Armour Rocket'. Has both physical (72) and EMP (24) damage.

mechanics_text: A sentry gun, when launched, stays in its place and automatically fires upon any hostile targets in range until it or they are destroyed.
There can only be a maximum of 3 operational sentry guns in an area at any given time.
They can cause friendly fire, and are able to be healed by repair beams.
Players are also able to destroy them in order to place new ones at different locations.
Sentry guns despawn if you travel to another station's orbit or enter a station.
Supernova DLC.
Berger SG-100.version_notes: Supernova DLC autonomous sentry gun (deploys in space, auto-fires on hostiles). Max 3 active at once. Supernova DLC.

mechanics_text: Upgraded sentry gun with higher damage and range than Berger SG-100.
Supernova DLC.
Berger SG-400.version_notes: Supernova DLC. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Homing missile with high both physical and EMP damage. Very long range.
Dephase EMP.version_notes: Stats from category table. Longest-range missile.

mechanics_text: Missiles are more expensive, but they can home in on targets and have much more range than rockets.
All missiles look the same after fired.
Edo.version_notes: Homing missile. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Upgraded EMP bomb with massive EMP damage and largest AoE radius.
EMP bombs deal little direct damage, but deal massive EMP damage in a large area to temporarily disable ships.
Area-of-effect EMP weapon with 11000m blast radius.
EMP GL I.version_notes: Area of effect (AoE) weapon. Magnitude = blast radius.

mechanics_text: EMP bomb with larger blast radius and higher EMP damage than EMP GL I.
EMP-focused rocket — low physical damage but significant EMP damage to disable ships.
EMP Rocket Mk I.version_notes: Primarily EMP damage. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Upgraded EMP rocket — higher both physical and EMP damage.
Supernova DLC. Technically a nuke but deals only 1 damage.
Extremely fast projectile speed (30000 km/h). Used for display or mischief.
Tech level 10 — highest in the game.
Fireworks.version_notes: Unusual weapon — deals only 1 damage despite nuke classification. Has fastest projectile speed of any weapon at 30000 km/h. Supernova DLC.

mechanics_text: Cluster missile — spiraling tracking. Supernova DLC.
Garuda-IV.version_notes: Supernova DLC. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Rockets are fast and cheap, but do not have much range and cannot be guided.
All rockets look the same after fired.
G'liissk.version_notes: Price per unit (secondary weapons are consumables). Cheapest secondary weapon.

mechanics_text: Homing missile with both physical and EMP damage. Very long range.
Ionizing Missiles do no significant damage, but they are the only way to harvest plasma clouds.
Always have a plasma turret ready to suck them all in!
Effect 50% means it ionizes 50% of the plasma cloud radius.
Supernova DLC.
Ion Lambda MK1.version_notes: Supernova DLC. Used with plasma turrets to harvest plasma. Effect% refers to plasma yield. No combat damage.

mechanics_text: Upgraded ionizing missile — 100% plasma ionization efficiency and larger range.
Supernova DLC.
Ion Lambda MK2.version_notes: Supernova DLC. 100% effect = fully ionizes plasma clouds. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Rocket — fast, cheap, short range, cannot be guided.
Mine with large proximity radius (2500m) and high damage. 60 second lifetime.
Valkyrie DLC.
Ksann'k.version_notes: Valkyrie DLC mine. High damage mine with 2500m trigger radius.

mechanics_text: Steerable nuke with very long range (13800m) and high damage (850).
Valkyrie DLC weapon.
Unlike other nukes, it can be steered toward the target.
Liberator.version_notes: Valkyrie DLC. Only steerable nuke. Highest damage nuke despite tech level 4 classification. Stats: damage=850, loading_speed_ms=10000, range_m=13800, magnitude_m=12500.

mechanics_text: EMP-only homing missile. No physical damage. Very long range.
Mamba EMP.version_notes: EMP damage only (0 physical). Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: EMP mine — no physical damage, but massive EMP damage (500) to disable ships. 50 second lifetime.
Valkyrie DLC.
Neétha EMP.version_notes: Valkyrie DLC EMP mine. Name contains accented character: 'Neétha'. URL: Ne%C3%A9tha_EMP.

mechanics_text: Kaamo Club exclusive cluster missile. Highest damage cluster missile.
Patala.version_notes: Kaamo Club exclusive. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Cluster missiles fly in elegant spirals toward their target and deal quite a bit of damage.
Their range is also quite impressive.
Supernova DLC weapon.
Detonates like a mine when used, punches like a nuke, and stings like an EMP bomb.
Supernova DLC. Deploys at ship location and immediately detonates in a 40000m sphere.
Range 0 and Speed 0 — deploys at user position, no projectile.
Shock Blast.version_notes: Supernova DLC. Unique weapon — deploys at ship position (range 0, speed 0). Both physical (140) and EMP (80) damage in 40000m AoE.

mechanics_text: Homing missile with long range.
S'koon.version_notes: DB/catalog name 'S'koon' but wiki page is 'S'koonn' (extra 'n'). URL is S%27koonn.

mechanics_text: Kaamo Club exclusive sentry gun — highest DPS sentry gun.
Comes pre-installed with a Sh'gaal blaster weapon.
T'Suum.version_notes: Kaamo Club exclusive. Stats from category table. Pre-installed with Sh'gaal as weapon.

mechanics_text: Automatic turrets fire on any hostiles in range and can be a great help in battle or as a defense when mining in hostile territories such as Void Space.
Automatic turrets can be toggled off by a stylized turret button above the right-hand control pad.
Valkyrie DLC — first automatic turret introduced.
Berger AGT 20mm.version_notes: Valkyrie DLC. First auto turret. turret_autonomous=true. Very fast firing rate (100ms).

mechanics_text: Manual turrets have to be controlled manually by pressing the switch view button.
While controlling the turret, the ship cannot be steered and proceeds on its current heading.
Manual turrets can provide a long-range, high-damage method of attack while retreating from battle.
Handling 40 — slowest rotating turret.
Hammerhead D1.version_notes: Manual turret. Handling = rotation speed. Confirmed 'Handling: 40' from category table (not to be confused with Speed).

mechanics_text: Manual turret — requires player control. Better handling (60) than D1.
Automatic turret with highest handling (150) and longest range of auto turrets.
Valkyrie DLC.
HH-AT \"Archimedes\".version_notes: Valkyrie DLC. Highest DPS among Valkyrie auto turrets despite same tech as Skuld.

mechanics_text: Manual turret with excellent handling (100) and long range.
L'ksaar.version_notes: Vossk weapon. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Supernova DLC manual turret with highest DPS of all turrets.
Matador TS.version_notes: Supernova DLC. Note: wiki category page shows low price as '466.548' (using period as thousands separator), should be $466,548. Confirmed from context.

mechanics_text: Upgraded plasma collector with longer range (5000m) and better handling.
Supernova DLC.
PE Ambipolar-5.version_notes: Supernova DLC. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Best plasma collector — 100% efficiency, longest range. Kaamo Club exclusive.
Supernova DLC.
PE Fusion H2.version_notes: Supernova DLC and Kaamo Club exclusive. 100% plasma collection. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Plasma Collectors are non-combat turrets used to harvest Plasma from gas clouds in space.
Used with Ion Lambda ionizing missiles to harvest plasma.
Supernova DLC.
Magnitude 80% = collection efficiency.
PE Proton.version_notes: Non-combat turret. Supernova DLC. Speed is tractor-beam speed, not projectile. Magnitude% = plasma harvesting efficiency.

mechanics_text: Automatic turret. Valkyrie DLC.
Skuld AT XR.version_notes: Valkyrie DLC auto turret. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Tractor beams bring loot into cargo hold from destroyed or EMPed ships or asteroids.
Manual — must be aimed at target. 4 second lock time.
AB-1 \"Retractor\".version_notes: Manual tractor beam. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Faster manual tractor beam — 1.8 second lock time.
Semi-automatic tractor beam — covers forward 180 degrees, instant lock (0ms). Automatically grabs loot in front arc.
AB-3 \"Kingfisher\".version_notes: Semi-auto (forward 180°). Instant lock. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Full 360° automatic tractor beam — grabs all loot around ship instantly. Valkyrie DLC.
AB-4 \"Octopus\".version_notes: Valkyrie DLC. Full omni-directional auto tractor. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Increases cargo hold by 25%.
Shield with capacity 150. Fast recharge (45s) relative to capacity.
Transfusion Beams take energy from enemy ships and heal one's own ship.
Drain 50% of enemy ship's energy. 1 pulse. Supernova DLC.
Drains from enemy, heals self — good for regenerating shields mid-combat.
Crimson Drain.version_notes: Supernova DLC. Energy drain on enemy, healing on self. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: 80% speed boost for 4400ms. Recharge 10000ms.
Successor to Linear Boost.
70% handling increase. Vossk thruster.
Armor plating adds to the ship's base armor HP.
E2 Exoclad.version_notes: Lowest-tier armor. Stats from category table.

Emergency System.in_game_description: This Emergency system creates a temporary impenetrable shield around the ship as soon as it reaches a critical level of damage. After the activation, the module becomes unusable and has to be bought again. The Galactic Tourist Agency is considering the introduction of a law that obligates all cruise ship companies to install these on their vessels.
mechanics_text: Creates a temporary impenetrable shield for 10000ms (10 seconds) when ship reaches critical damage.
After activation, the module is consumed and must be repurchased.
Cannot use the Khador Drive when Emergency System is active, but can still cloak.
Only available with the Valkyrie add-on.
Required for the Grave Riser orange medal (get 5 kills while Emergency System is active).
Emergency System.version_notes: CRITICAL: Effect 10000ms is the DURATION of the emergency shield in milliseconds (10 seconds). This is NOT a multiplier or percentage. Previous parser bug interpreted this as effect_multiplier: 10000.0 — INCORRECT. Consumable module.

mechanics_text: High-capacity shield (220). Slow recharge (60 seconds). Non-Supernova top-tier shield.
Gamma Shields protect from gamma radiation in the Ginoya system, affected by the supernova.
Without protection, ships take constant damage from radiation in the Ginoya system.
Gamma Shield I provides 40% radiation protection — requires Supernova DLC.
None of the regular shields provide any protection against gamma radiation.
Gamma Shield I.version_notes: Supernova DLC. Gamma radiation protection — effect_pct = percentage of radiation blocked. Regular shields do NOT protect against gamma radiation.

mechanics_text: Provides 60% gamma radiation protection. Upgraded version of Gamma Shield I.
Supernova DLC. Required to safely operate in Ginoya system.
Gamma Shield II.version_notes: Supernova DLC. H'Belam discrepancy: wiki shows H'Belam as tech_level 5 in category table (vs DB value 5), but wiki item page has been noted as showing level 6. Using category table value for now.

mechanics_text: Best mining drill — 100% handling and 100% yield. Maximum efficiency.
Gunant's Drill.version_notes: Highest-tier mining drill. Stats from category table.

H'Belam.in_game_description: H'Belam means 'father' and describes a powerful Vossk shield that was released for sale to all races. The Vossk themselves tend to prefer stronger armor than the H'Belam, however, which cannot compete with the top models on the market.
mechanics_text: Only Vossk shield in the game.
Slow recharge time (58 seconds).
Vossk prefer armor over shields, so H'Belam was made available to all races.
H'Belam.version_notes: DISCREPANCY: DB has tech_level=5, wiki infobox shows tech_level=6. Wiki infobox authoritative — capturing tech_level=6. Category table also shows tech level 5 in the Equipment category page. This is the known H'Belam discrepancy. Price: '32.473$' on wiki uses period as European thousands separator — parsed as $32,473.

mechanics_text: Fast scanner — 1.8 second lock time. Shows cargo. Does not show Class A asteroids.
Hiroto Proscan.version_notes: Stats from category table. Price reconstructed from partial data in category page (split across offset reads).

mechanics_text: Best scanner — 1.8 second lock, shows cargo, shows Class A asteroids on radar.
Mining drills extract ores from asteroids.
Handling = drill maneuverability when drilling.
Yield = percentage of ore extracted per drill.
IMT Extract 1.3.version_notes: Stats from category table. 'Handling' for mining drills is drill rotation speed, not ship handling. 'Yield' is ore extraction efficiency.

mechanics_text: Mining drill with balanced handling/yield ratio.
High-yield mining drill (80%) with good handling (70%).
IMT Extract 4.0X.version_notes: URL contains BOM character (\uFEFF) before '4.0X': 'IMT_Extract\uFEFF_4.0X'. Wiki slug quirk — URL is 'IMT_Extract﻿_4.0X'. Known issue from task description.

mechanics_text: Repair Bots automatically make in-flight repairs to a ship's armor and hull.
Continuous passive repair while equipped.
Ketar Repair Bot.version_notes: Stats from category table. HP/s not listed in category table — individual page needs fetching for exact repair rate.

mechanics_text: Upgraded repair bot — faster repair rate than Ketar Repair Bot. Valkyrie DLC.
Ketar Repair Bot II.version_notes: Valkyrie DLC. HP/s not listed in category table — needs individual page for exact rate.

mechanics_text: Jump drive that allows fast travel between star systems.
Required for interstellar travel (unless built into ship).
All Deep Science ships come with an integrated Khador Drive that does NOT occupy an equipment slot.
Activation time 5000ms (5 seconds). Energy consumption varies by distance.
Cannot be used when Emergency System is active.
Khador Drive.version_notes: Essential for interstellar travel. Deep Science ships have integrated version (free slot). Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Vossk mining drill — high handling (80%) but lower yield (40%).
Largest cabin — capacity 10 passengers. For passenger missions.

Linear Boost.in_game_description: Briefly increase your ship's top speed. The Linear Boost is the cheapest booster on the market, but also the least reliable.
mechanics_text: Boosters are activated by pressing an upwards-turned fast-forward button at the bottom of the HUD.
After the boost has been used, a certain amount of time must pass before it can be used again, indicated by the button fading.
Effect 60% = speed increase of 60% above base speed (Keith's base ~450 km/h → 720 km/h with Linear Boost).
Duration 3000ms = boost lasts 3 seconds.
Loading speed 8000ms = 8 second recharge time before next use.
Cheapest booster in the game.
Linear Boost.version_notes: Verification item: tech_level=4, effect_pct=60, effect_multiplier=1.6, duration_ms=3000, loading_speed_ms=8000. All confirmed from individual wiki page. The 'Effect' row = speed boost percentage, 'Loading speed' = recharge time, 'Boost duration' = active time.

mechanics_text: 200% speed boost for 6000ms. Recharge 16000ms. Vossk booster.
Cabin for passenger missions. Capacity 5 passengers.
Doubles ship handling (100% increase). Vossk thruster.
Weapon Mods modify primary weapon performance.
Overcharge: sacrifice 10% fire rate for +20% damage per shot.
Mounted in equipment slot. Valkyrie DLC.
Nirai Overcharge.version_notes: Valkyrie DLC weapon mod. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Weapon Mod: sacrifice 10% damage per shot for +20% fire rate.
Valkyrie DLC.
Nirai Overdrive.version_notes: Valkyrie DLC. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Repair Beams automatically aim at friendly ships and sentry guns in range.
Provides energy to fill shields and repair armor on friendly ships.
SPP-C1: 1500m range, 60% repair effect, 1 pulse per activation.
Nirai SPP-C1.version_notes: Repair beam heals friendly ships/sentry guns. 'Effect' = repair amount per pulse. 'Count' = number of pulses. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Kaamo Club exclusive repair beam. Long range (6000m), 100% repair, 3 pulses. Best repair beam.
Nirai SPP-M50.version_notes: Kaamo Club exclusive. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Higher-tier transfusion beam — 100% drain, 3 pulses, but shorter range (1000m). Supernova DLC.
Pandora Leech.version_notes: Supernova DLC. Shorter range but more powerful drain. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Supernova DLC shield with highest capacity (380) and relatively fast recharge (55s). Best shield in game.
Particle Shield.version_notes: Supernova DLC. Highest capacity shield. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: 40% handling increase.

Phoenix SIS.in_game_description: The Shield Injector automatically charges empty shields with energy. In order to do so, a certain amount of blue plasma is required.
mechanics_text: Phoenix SIS (Phoenix Shield Injecting System) quickly refills a depleted shield.
Activates automatically when shield depletes from sustained damage.
Recharges shield within ~5 seconds.
Requires 30t of blue plasma per activation.
Can recharge indefinitely as long as 30t blue plasma is available.
Effectively creates 'infinite' shield if damage rate equals regeneration rate.
Blueprint-only item — must be crafted, cannot be purchased normally.
Keith discovers the blueprint: 'I've been looking for the blueprint for a shield injector for almost a decade.'
Phoenix SIS.version_notes: Blueprint-only. Consumes 30t blue plasma per activation. GoF2 HD Android has significantly higher price. Shield injector auto-triggers when shield is empty.

mechanics_text: 300% speed boost for 6000ms. Recharge 16000ms. Valkyrie DLC booster.
Polytron Boost.version_notes: Valkyrie DLC. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: 130% handling increase. Plasma-powered thruster.
Pulsed Plasma Thrust.version_notes: Stats from category table. Uses plasma as noted in name but mechanically same as other thrusters.

mechanics_text: Doubles cargo hold (100% increase). Best cargo compressor.

Rhoda Vortex.in_game_description: Known for their paradox developments, the Rhoda company has launched another incredible product on the market. During quantum radiation, a secretion extracted from the saliva of the Prosperian protofly generates a dilation field that slows down time for the user.
mechanics_text: Slows down time around the player by about 50% for 15 seconds (as perceived by the user).
While Effect=15000ms is the perceived duration, only 7500ms actually pass in real time.
Loading speed=30000ms = 30 second recharge time.
Makes combat, mining, hacking, and plasma gathering significantly easier.
Activated by a clock-face button on the left side of the screen.
Button disappears during mining, hacking, and fast-forwarding — can only slow non-combat tasks if activated right before the task.
Everything in flight slows down including travel speed.
Rhoda Vortex.version_notes: Effect=15000ms is the PERCEIVED time dilation duration (15s from user's perspective = 7.5s real time). Loading speed=30000ms recharge. Only 7.5s pass in reality.

mechanics_text: Capacity 80, very slow recharge (46 seconds).
Increases cargo hold by 75%.

Sight Suppressor II.in_game_description: Stealth generators can hide a ship from prying eyes almost completely. It lasts for a short time and is useful for sneaking up on enemies or quickly escaping dangerous situations. The Sight Suppressor II is an entry level model.
mechanics_text: For two energy cells, a ship can turn invisible in 6.5 seconds (loading_speed=6500ms) and remain so for 20 seconds (duration=20000ms).
While invisible, no other pilots can track your ship, stopping all fire.
Entry-level Terran cloak.
Despite long charging time, has double the cloak duration of the U'tool.

gof2_hd_overrides._note: GoF2 HD Android single source at Ni'mrrod only, same price at min and max.

Sight Suppressor II.version_notes: CRITICAL: Effect=20000ms = CLOAK DURATION, not a multiplier. GoF2 HD Android has only one station (Ni'mrrod at $65,146).

Signature Midorian.in_game_description: Signatures are unique identification codes that store biometric data, political slants and the Spacenet surfing behaviour of the respective pilot.
mechanics_text: Same mechanics as Signature Terran but for Midorian faction identity.
Signature Midorian.version_notes: Shares /wiki/Signature page with other faction signatures.

Signature Nivelian.in_game_description: Signatures are unique identification codes that store biometric data, political slants and the Spacenet surfing behaviour of the respective pilot.

Signature Nivelian.version_notes: Shares /wiki/Signature page with other faction signatures.

Signature Terran.in_game_description: Signatures are unique identification codes that store biometric data, political slants and the Spacenet surfing behaviour of the respective pilot. Data privacy experts are critical towards their application and warn against abuse. Spies can take advantage of this security gap to act behind enemy lines without revealing their identity.
mechanics_text: Equipping a Signature makes that faction treat you as friendly; opposing factions become hostile.
Only one signature can be equipped at a time.
Signature becomes invalid if you attack the faction whose signature you're wearing.
Can be obtained by destroying ships of the target faction.
Or purchased for ~500,000 credits in the Loma system.
Signatures not available for Pirates, Voids, Deep Science, or Valkyrie factions.
Selling price is ~7,500 credits (black market item, sold almost anywhere).
Glitch: can retain signature while attacking friendly if Yin Co. Shadow Ninja cloak is active.
Signature Terran.version_notes: Shared page with all 4 Signature variants (Terran, Vossk, Nivelian, Midorian). No infobox stats on wiki page — purely mechanical/behavioral item.

Signature Vossk.in_game_description: Signatures are unique identification codes that store biometric data, political slants and the Spacenet surfing behaviour of the respective pilot.
mechanics_text: Same mechanics as Signature Terran but for Vossk faction identity.
Signature Vossk.version_notes: Shares /wiki/Signature page with other faction signatures.

mechanics_text: Cabins transport people for passenger missions.
Cabin Size 3 = capacity for 3 passengers.
Best spectral filter — shows plasma clouds on radar AND provides cloud info. Kaamo Club exclusive.
Supernova DLC.
Spectral Filter Omega.version_notes: Supernova DLC + Kaamo Club exclusive. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Spectral filters use false color rendering to locate plasma gas clouds.
Makes otherwise invisible gas clouds visible — used for plasma harvesting.
SA-1: basic filter — lets you see plasma visually but not on radar, no info shown.
Spectral Filter SA-1.version_notes: Supernova DLC. Required to see plasma clouds for harvesting. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Shows plasma cloud information (yield, composition), but not on radar.
Spectral Filter ST-X.version_notes: Supernova DLC. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Thrusters (also known as Steering Nozzles) increase ship handling and overall maneuverability.
Effect 20% = 20% increase to ship handling stat.
Static Thrust.version_notes: Thruster effect % is handling increase. handling_multiplier = 1 + effect_pct/100.

mechanics_text: 160% speed boost for 5600ms. Recharge 12000ms.
Shield absorbs damage until energy runs out. Recharges over time.
Shields do not protect against gamma radiation in Supernova's Ginoya system.
Targe Shield: weakest shield, capacity 50, 20 second recharge time.
Targe Shield.version_notes: Loading speed = shield recharge time, not activation time. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Shows enemy cargo contents when scanner locked. 3 second lock time.
Scanners allow you to target hostiles, asteroids, etc.
Without scanners it's impossible to differentiate friendly ships from enemy ships.
Telta Quickscan — basic scanner, 4 second lock time, no special features.

T'yol.version_notes: Highest-tier armor. Stats from category table.

mechanics_text: Increases cargo hold by 40%.

U'tool.in_game_description: The Vossk U'tool is a very powerful device. Rumor has it that each of them is connected to a central Vossk computer that can disable the unit remotely. Because of the uncertainty over the U'tool's security, the device is not as popular as the Terran-built Sight Suppressor series.
mechanics_text: For one energy cell, a ship can turn invisible in two seconds (loading_speed_ms=2000) and remain so for ten seconds (duration_ms=10000).
While invisible, no other pilots can track your ship, stopping all fire towards you.
Enemies are still unable to track you despite being able to see the projectiles and muzzle flashes coming from your ship.
Fast loading speed is ideal for pilots who need quick breaks from intense firefights.
The Scimitar and Specter are pre-installed with the U'tool.
Despite being the least used cloak, the energy cell to cloak duration ratio is the best of all three cloaks.
Cannot be disabled remotely despite the in-game description.
U'tool.version_notes: CRITICAL: Effect=10000ms is CLOAK DURATION in milliseconds, NOT a multiplier. Previous parser bug would interpret this incorrectly. Loading speed=2000ms is the charging time before cloak activates. GoF2 HD Android has significantly higher price ($97,544 vs $37,717 min). Verification: tech_level=6, duration_ms=10000, loading_speed_ms=2000, energy_per_use=1 — all confirmed.

Yin Co. Shadow Ninja.in_game_description: A very efficient stealth generator that is believed to be custom built. Should this device make it into mass-production, space will become a very empty place.
mechanics_text: For five energy cells, a ship can turn invisible in 3.5 seconds (loading_speed=3500ms) and remain so for 40 seconds (duration=40000ms).
While invisible, no other pilots can track your ship.
Cannot be purchased from space stations — must be built from a blueprint.
Blueprint found in E'kkide station, K'ontrr System.
Extended 40-second cloak time is ideal for mining, hacking containers, and surviving hostile areas.
Despite high energy cost (5 cells), considered best cloak due to longest duration.
Yin Co. Shadow Ninja.version_notes: CRITICAL: Effect=40000ms = CLOAK DURATION (40 seconds). Blueprint-only item. Highest tech level (10) cloak.

mechanics_text: Increases cargo hold by 15%. Multiple compressors stack additively.
Cheapest cargo compressor.
ZMI Optistore.version_notes: Cargo compressor — effect_pct = cargo increase %. Stats from category table.

Betty.in_game_description: This ship is used by the Mido as an interplanetary shuttle. It's small, lightweight and relatively fast, but it's definitely not something a pilot should attempt to take into a fight.

Originally a pirate ship that Gunant repaired and outfitted with Midorian technology.
Weakest ship in the game with lowest statistics.
Can be repurchased later at Var Hastra in the Mido System.
Despite being weak, serves well as a starter ship for learning the game.
